# Danny McGiffin

Danny McGiffin is a workflow automation and AI consultant based in Herndon, Virginia, serving businesses across Northern Virginia and the Washington, DC area.

He helps small and midsize businesses improve workflows, automate manual work, integrate systems, and implement AI. The working method is: understand the work, improve the system, then automate what should not require human effort.

## Location

Based in Herndon, Virginia. Works with businesses in Northern Virginia and the Washington, DC area, including Reston, Chantilly, Fairfax, Tysons, McLean, Vienna, Ashburn, Leesburg, Arlington, Alexandria, Loudoun County, and Fairfax County.
